openQuestions.decisionPoint: Whether to create an incoming inspection work order
openQuestions.promptText: Create an Incoming Inspection Work Order? YES//
openQuestions.default: data-driven — YES if ^ENG(6910.2 piece 2 = 2, otherwise NO
openQuestions.codedBehavior: Prompt appears only if ^ENG(6910.2 'ASK INCOMING INSPECTION W.O.' is enabled; if the user answers YES, IIWO^ENWONEW3 creates a 6920 work order.
openQuestions.whatIsNotCoded: NO item property decides YES vs NO — the choice is left to the user at runtime. The 'LOCKOUT REQUIRED -> mandatory WO' logic exists in the modern Equipment.Production but is NOT in the legacy ENEQ1; encoding it would be an incorrect assumption.
candidateInterpretations: only when the item requires incoming inspection per site policy

evidence: ENEQ1 ADDEQ inspection-WO block: user's prompt answer drives IIWO^ENWONEW3; no coded item-condition

openQuestions.decisionPoint: Whether to enroll the item in the PM program
openQuestions.promptText: Would you like to include this item in the PM program YES//
openQuestions.codedBehavior: Prompt shown only to holders of key ENEDPM; if YES, XNPMSE^ENEQPMP (or DINV^ENEQPMP3) enrolls the item.
openQuestions.whatIsNotCoded: Which items warrant PM enrollment is a user/policy decision; not derivable from the record.

evidence: ENEQ1 ADDEQ PM block gated by ^XUSEC('ENEDPM',DUZ) + user prompt

openQuestions.decisionPoint: Whether to keep the clerk's override on the FA report (legacy policy: report every capitalized NX item to FAP)
openQuestions.promptText: Do you wish to send an FA document to Austin YES//
openQuestions.codedBehavior: Legacy POLICY: capitalized NX equipment is reported to FAP. ENEQ1 ADDEQ carries it out at entry: for TYPE OF ENTRY = NX and INVESTMENT CATEGORY = 1 it prompts the ENFACS key holder 'Do you wish to send an FA document to Austin' with default YES; YES calls ^ENFAACQ. A NO is a clerk override: the new-equipment bulletin then flags 'It was NOT reported to FAP', and the item can be reported later (^ENFAACQ is also called from ENEQ2, ENEQ3, ENFADEL, ENFAXMTM and in batch by CMR or station).
openQuestions.whatIsNotCoded: When a clerk may override the report (answer NO) has no coded criteria — the override is an exception path, not the policy.
candidateInterpretations: carry the policy over: report every capitalized NX item to FAP, with no override
hold for financial review in some cases
